notes: Platform registry of MCP servers an agent role may be granted (docs/design/enhancement-proposals-2026-10.md, item 2).
A profile grants a server by name in its `mcp_servers` list; agents/validate_profiles.py rejects grants that are not registered here.
At container boot apps/paperclip/render-hermes-mcp.py renders the servers named in AAF_MCP_SERVERS into the Hermes config.yaml `mcp_servers` block.
A server with `auth.secret_env` is rendered only when that env var is set (Key Vault-mounted); it is skipped, loudly, otherwise. Nothing else from the environment is ever copied into the config.
`tools.include` is the least-privilege allow-list Hermes enforces per server; keep it explicit for anything that can write.
